name: coding_agent
description: Run one locked-down Claude Agent SDK coding session in a worktree (dontAsk + worktree-escape guard). Input: prompt, worktreePath.

worktreePath.description: Absolute path to the git worktree the agent session runs in; required.

prompt.description: Inline prompt text. Used verbatim if promptTemplate/templateKey resolve nothing; otherwise a safety fallback.

promptTemplate.description: Highest-precedence prompt source: inline template text, or '@relative/path' to read a template file from the worktree. Rendered against promptContext.

templateKey.description: Template name used to look up a repo '.conductor/<key>.md' override or the bundled 'workers/defaults/prompts/<key>.md' default.

promptContext.description: Variables used to render the chosen template (promptTemplate, repo template, or bundled default).

promptTemplateSource.description: Caller-supplied label for which template source was requested; recorded in logs/output only.

contextFiles.description: Comma-separated string or array of file paths (must live under OPENSPEC_SNAPSHOT_DIR) whose contents are appended to the prompt as read-only external context, capped at 512 KiB total.

contextPaths.description: Comma-separated string or array of absolute filesystem paths (files or directories, no symlinks) granted to the agent as read-only live context references.

schema.description: JSON Schema (object or JSON string) constraining the agent's structured output. When it matches the campaign task-DAG shape, an explicit plan contract is appended to the prompt and the result is validated/normalized as a campaign plan.

modelRole.description: Model-policy role used to select the model tier (design, plan, code, review, judge, scribe).

model.description: Compatibility override: explicit model id for this role, backend inferred from the id.

fallbackModel.description: Model to fall back to if the primary model errors.

effort.description: Backend-specific reasoning/effort level passed through to the agent session.

modelResolution.description: Precomputed model-policy resolution (e.g. from model_profile_resolve); reused unless the worktree carries its own repository policy.

modelsConfig.description: Relative path inside the worktree to a repository model policy file, used when (re)resolving modelResolution.

modelProfile.description: Named model-policy profile to select when (re)resolving modelResolution.

modelPolicy.description: Inline model policy document to merge when (re)resolving modelResolution.

modelPolicySha256.description: Expected SHA-256 of the inline modelPolicy.

maxTurns.description: Cap on agent turns for this session; combined with the resolved model tier's own limit (the lower wins).

maxBudgetUsd.description: Cap on USD spend for this session; combined with the resolved model tier's own limit (the lower wins).

resumeSessionId.description: Prior agent session id to resume instead of starting a cold session.

allowedDomains.description: Comma-separated string or array of network domains the agent session may reach.

allowedWriteRoots.description: Comma-separated string or array of repository-relative path prefixes the agent may write to; changes outside these roots are reverted after the session.

settingSources.description: Which Claude settings sources to load: a string/array of sources, or '', 'none', '[]' to load none (untrusted-repo lockdown). Defaults to the CODING_AGENT_SETTING_SOURCES env var or ['project'].

tools.description: Comma-separated string or array restricting the available built-in tool surface (can only narrow, never widen, the default tool set).

allowedTools.description: Comma-separated string or array of explicitly allowed tools.

disallowedTools.description: Comma-separated string or array of explicitly disallowed tools.

includeFileTree.description: Set to 'false'/'0'/'no' to skip priming the prompt with a directory listing.

includeRepoGuide.description: Set to 'false'/'0'/'no' to skip priming the prompt with the repo's AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md guide.

failSoft.description: When true, agent/policy failures are returned as a COMPLETED task with status/error fields set instead of failing the task.

status.description: Terminal agent session status, e.g. success, error_max_turns, error_max_budget_usd, policy_denied, invalid_plan.

agentCompleted.description: True only if the agent session itself reported ok; independent of downstream build/test verification.

verificationState.description: Always 'pending'; independent verification has not yet run when this task completes.

agent.description: Backend that ran the session: claude, codex, or gemini.

model.description: Model id actually used for the session.

modelResolution.description: Effective model-policy resolution used for this session.

role.description: Model-policy role this session ran as.

tier.description: Selected model tier: {agent, model, maxTurns, maxBudgetUsd, priceKey, availability, ...}.

canonicalSha256.description: SHA-256 of the resolved policy used for drift detection.

sources.description: Provenance of the merged policy layers.

filesChanged.description: Repository-relative paths the agent changed and that survived scope enforcement.

fileChanges.description: Per-file status for the changed set.

status.description: Git status code: A (added), M (modified), D (deleted), or R (renamed).

result.description: The agent's final text response, truncated to 2000 characters.

structured.description: The agent's structured output matching the requested schema, if any; may be null.

planValidation.description: Campaign-plan validation result ({valid, errors, tasks, order}) when schema matched the campaign plan contract; empty object otherwise.

sessionId.description: Backend session id for this run, usable as resumeSessionId; empty string if unavailable.

turns.description: Per-turn log entries (turn number, commands run, tokens).

numTurns.description: Total number of agent turns taken.

tokenUsed.description: Total tokens consumed by the session.

costUsd.description: Total USD cost of the session.

denials.description: Human-readable log of every tool call or change the harness denied or reverted.

contextPaths.description: Validated live context path entries granted to this session.

promptTemplate.description: Which prompt template source was requested vs. actually resolved.

resolvedSource.description: Actual source the prompt was resolved from (input:inline, repo:@path, repo:.conductor/<key>.md, bundled:<key>, or workflow:inline-prompt).

templateKey.description: Template key that was used, if any.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the rendered prompt template.

retryable.description: Set only on a failure/failSoft path: true if the failure (error_max_turns/error_max_budget_usd) can be retried via resumeSessionId.

error.description: Set only on a failure/failSoft path: human-readable error message.

stderr.description: Set only on a failure/failSoft path: captured stderr tail, truncated to 2000 characters.
